column1: # Entries every build must contain: zip stem, term, reading (tab-separated). scripts/validate.ts
# fails the build when one is missing, so a parser change that drops or mangles them is caught
# before a release. Covers plain words, multiple readings, traditional and variant forms (also
# the ones listed with "*", sense numbers or a range), the neutral tone, readings that carried a
# note or separators in the source, sub-headwords behind an @@@LINK, letter words and characters
# The traditional forms the build adds (dics/traditional.ts): words, Taiwan forms of characters,
# sub-headwords, and the spellings of Hong Kong and of OpenCC's default conversion, which are
# only looked up. A line whose stem starts with "!" is a row that must NOT be there: a form that
# belongs to another entry of the character (髮 is fà, 發 fā), a word swapped for Taiwan's own
